Hi, I’m Dr. Olivia — a pediatric physical therapist, digital educator, and host of The Baby Development Podcast.
I help parents feel more confident supporting their babies and toddlers through expert-led education on development, movement, milestones, feeding, play, and real-life parenting.

Here you’ll find practical baby development tips, product recommendations, podcast episodes with trusted experts, and simple strategies you can use at home.

Follow me everywhere: @dr.oliviaofficial
Podcast: @thebabydevelopmentpod
For business inquiries: Olivia@thebabypt.com
